children: FS Credit Opportunities announced Walter W. Buckley, III was elected as a Class I director while the vote on Barbara J. Fouss remains adjourned due to lack of a preferred-stock quorum.
Walter W. Buckley, III elected as Class I director for a three-year term ending 2029.
Vote on Barbara J. Fouss adjourned at Annual Meeting due to no preferred-stock quorum.
Meeting reconvened twice (Sept 8 and Sept 24) and adjourned each time for same quorum issue.
Next reconvened meeting scheduled for Oct 6 at 11:00 a.m. ET in Philadelphia to consider Fouss election.
